mentions.name: deadwood-rs
mentions.description: A Rust tool that finds dead code left behind by LLMs. Created as a Rust equivalent of fallow, it helps identify unused code remaining after AI-assisted rewrites to Rust.
mentions.problem: LLM-assisted code rewrites (such as rewriting codebases into Rust) leave dead code behind in projects.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Just released this: https://github.com/rlorenzo/deadwood-rs

Since everyone is rewriting everything into Rust I created a tool akin to fallow (https://fallow.tools), but for Rust:

Finds dead code that LLMs leave behind.
